title.zh: 批准第5196号共和国法所授特许权的转让、让与、出售或抵押的法案
title.en: An Act Approving the Transfer, Assignment, Sale or Mortgage of the Franchise Granted Under Republic Act Numbered Five Thousand One Hundred Ninety-Six.
title.orig: An Act Approving the Transfer, Assignment, Sale or Mortgage of the Franchise Granted Under Republic Act Numbered Five Thousand One Hundred Ninety-Six.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6307_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution and to the terms and conditions of the franchise granted under Republic Act Numbered Five thousand one hundred ninety-six, the transfer, assignment, sale or mortgage of said franchise together with all the rights and privileges granted thereunder in favor of any banking or financing institution or any individual, corporation, co-partnership or joint-stock company, is hereby approved.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1971.
